companies.name: ベイビュー・ファイナンシャル

relations.text: ベイビューの住宅ローンの業務受託を行い、2025年末の元本残高は1,569億ドルだった
relations.text_en: M&T sub-services residential mortgage loans for Bayview Financial, with $156.9 billion outstanding at December 31, 2025

source.label: M&T Bank 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: The Company sub-services residential mortgage loans for Bayview Financial having outstanding principal balances of $ 156.9 billion and $ 111.5 billion at December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.

companies.name: ベイビュー・レンディング・グループ

relations.text: ベイビュー・レンディング・グループの20%の少数持分を保有している
relations.text_en: M&T holds a 20% minority interest in Bayview Lending Group

source.label: M&T Bank 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: M&T holds a 20 % minority interest in BLG, a privately-held commercial mortgage company.

relations.text: 子会社のM&Tリアルティ・キャピタルがファニーメイのDUSプログラムに参加している
relations.text_en: M&T Realty Capital participates in the DUS program of Fannie Mae

source.label: M&T Bank 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: M&T Realty Capital, a commercial real estate lending subsidiary of M&T Bank, participates in the DUS program of Fannie Mae, pursuant to which commercial real estate loans are originated in accordance with terms and conditions specified by Fannie Mae and sold.

relations.text: フレディマックなどの集合住宅ローンプログラムで融資の実行と販売を行う
relations.text_en: Originates, sells and services loans under Freddie Mac's multifamily loan programs

source.label: M&T Bank 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: The Company’s involvement in commercial mortgage banking activities includes the origination, sales and servicing of loans under the multifamily loan programs of Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac
